links.outcome: Radiologist-rated accuracy (5-point Likert) of LLM answers to IR procedure patient questions
links.effect: OpenBioLLM-8b (BEST 3.51, CT-HDR 3.32, TAPE 3.34) and BioMistral-7b (BEST 2.92, CT-HDR 3.03, TAPE 3.33) scored significantly worse than DeepSeek-V3 and ChatGPT-4o (DeepSeek BEST 4.49, CT-HDR 4.24).
links.quote: In contrast, OpenBioLLM-8b (BEST 3.51 (± 1.15), CT-HDR 3.32 (± 1.13), TAPE 3.34 (± 1.16)) and BioMistral-7b (BEST 2.92 (± 1.35), CT-HDR 3.03 (± 1.06), TAPE 3.33 (± 1.28)) performed significantly worse than DeepSeek-V3 and ChatGPT-4o across all procedures.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates multiple LLMs on generating responses to common patient questions regarding interventional radiology procedures, evaluated by expert radiologists. It benchmarks accuracy without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
